name: ray-plugins
description: Ray Data Co's example Claude Code plugin marketplace — a minimal working template you can copy.

plugins.name: rdco-example
plugins.description: Minimal example plugin: two example skills (rdco-greeting + rdco-hello), skills-only. Copy this folder as a template for your own plugin.

plugins.name: copilot-studio-agent-builder
plugins.description: Guides the full lifecycle of building a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent (plan -> build -> test -> publish -> maintain) and emits five standard deliverables. Standardizes on generative orchestration; bakes in verified Microsoft Learn corrections + safe defaults (Work IQ off, newest Sonnet, grounded internal agents).

plugins.name: snowflake-cli
plugins.description: Teaches Claude Code to use the Snowflake CLI (`snow`) — primarily to execute SQL and deploy DDL — via a /prime-snow-cli index skill plus reference files that mirror the full `snow` command tree (connection, object, stage, snowpark, streamlit, app, spcs, cortex, dbt, git, notebook, dcm) with pointers to the official docs.

plugins.name: skill-agent-brigade
plugins.description: A brigade for building skills: a multi-agent assembly line (spec -> tests -> author -> critic, with a convergence loop) that forces depth in from a competency source and gates slop with independent critics. Stations hand off through file artifacts; the expo routes each ticket (advance / refire-to-author / reroute-to-spec / reroute-to-steward / kill). Ships the steward (front-of-house context curation), the expo, reference workflows (single-ticket + rail queue-walk), and the variance-analysis worked example.

plugins.name: ab-managerial-accounting
plugins.description: Managerial-accounting agent brigade (né discipline-skills): 5 eval-proven finance skills (variance-analysis, annual-budget-build, close-management, treasury-liquidity-analysis, debt-schedule), a menu/router skill that pairs a situation to the right skill, and a base-model-covered registry (5 tasks with eval-verified base-model coverage). Every skill ships with two-arm execution-eval evidence.

plugins.name: ab-data-engineering
plugins.description: Data-engineering agent brigade: eval-proven DE skills plus a menu/router skill. First skill: pipeline-failure-triage (+1.00 lift — classifies silent zero-row failures the base model misreads as transient infra). Menu carries honest status for the rest of the vertical (held-for-refire, weak-evidence, base-model-covered-pending).
